title: 2X
infotainment: 13.4-inch touchscreen powered by Unreal Engine, Google built-in, OnStar
adasStandard: Forward collision warning, automatic emergency braking, lane-keep assist, blind-spot warning, rear cross-traffic alert, HD Surround Vision (multi-camera 360 view). Source: https://www.kbb.com/gmc/hummer-ev-pickup/2025/specs/
adasOptional: Super Cruise hands-free driving on 400,000+ mi of compatible roads, with automatic lane change. Standard on 3X; optional/standard package on 2X. Sources: https://www.gmc.com/support/vehicle/driving-safety/driver-assistance/super-cruise
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard HD rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines; integrated into the HD Surround Vision multi-camera system. Source: https://www.gmc.com/electric/hummer-ev/pickup-truck
sideViewCameraNotes: HD Surround Vision provides a 360-degree multi-camera view; UltraVision camera package adds 14+ camera views including under-body trail-cam views for off-roading. Source: https://www.gmc.com/electric/hummer-ev/pickup-truck
subscriptionFeatures: OnStar Super Cruise plan ($25–$40/mo after 3-yr trial) — required to use Super Cruise hands-free. OnStar Premium remote services (remote start via app, vehicle status, navigation with traffic) subscription after trial; standard on Hummer EV with included trial. No heated-seat or performance-unlock subscriptions reported. Sources: https://gmauthority.com/blog/2025/05/gm-revises-onstar-plans-and-pricing/
drmNotes: Super Cruise requires active OnStar Super Cruise plan after 3-year trial ($25–$40/mo). OTA updates and remote start / remote diagnostics require OnStar connectivity. Vehicle drives without internet but loses connected-services features. Standard OnStar Premium on Hummer EV. Sources: https://www.onstar.com/support/faq/super-cruise ; https://gmauthority.com/blog/2025/05/gm-revises-onstar-plans-and-pricing/
killSwitchNotes: No dedicated impaired-driver kill switch as of MY2025. In-cabin driver-monitoring camera (used for Super Cruise attention monitoring) is present and could host future passive-impairment detection software per GM development plans. Sources: https://www.theautopian.com/new-cars-sold-in-america-will-be-actively-watching-and-judging-you-and-may-decide-to-not-let-you-drive/
knownIssues: Heavy curb weight stresses tires and suspension; reports of charging-software glitches and infotainment freezes typical of early Ultium-platform vehicles. Source: https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/gmc/hummer-ev/2025/reliability/
recalls: At least one NHTSA recall on record for 2025 Hummer EV. Check https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls for VIN-specific lookup. Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle/2025/GMC/HUMMER%20EV
stateIncentives: Federal $7,500 IRA credit expired Sept 30, 2025; Hummer EV exceeded $80,000 truck MSRP cap so was not eligible to most buyers even pre-expiration. State incentives vary (e.g., CO, NJ, NY EV rebates may apply; check residency). Sources: https://www.irs.gov/clean-vehicle-tax-credits
